steps.code:
# Get the list of following artists, paginating through all pages.
access_token = login_result['access_token']
all_artists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_artists.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total artists followed: {len(all_artists)}")
# Show the artists with their follower counts
for artist in all_artists:
    print(artist['name'], artist['follower_count'])
